title: Map-Reduce Document Summarization
signature: def summarize_docs(loop, summarize, docs, chunk_tokens, max_concurrency, batch_size)
hints: Chunk with range(0, len(toks), chunk_tokens) so the last, shorter chunk is kept.

Write one pool(texts) generator: spawn min(c, n) workers that pull the next index from a shared counter and store each result at its index. Calling yield from pool(...) returns the results in input order.
Each reduce level splits the list into consecutive batches. A batch of one passes through with no call; the others are joined with "\n" and summarized through the same pool.
Wrap the whole pipeline in one generator, spawn it, call loop.run(), and return the task's result.
